name: Asmamaw Alemayehu Abate
title: Civil Engineer and General Manager
headline: Civil Engineer | Construction Management | Infrastructure Development | Strategic Leadership
intro: Civil engineer with more than 15 years of experience in road construction, road maintenance and construction management. My career runs from site engineer to General Manager of a road works enterprise, and to the board of an insurance company.
supportingStatement: I lead the people, equipment, budgets and contracts that keep road infrastructure moving, and I hold a Master of Engineering in Construction Technology and Management from Bahir Dar University Institute of Technology.

biography: Asmamaw Alemayehu Abate is a civil engineer based in Bahir Dar, Ethiopia, whose career spans road construction, road maintenance operations, construction management and corporate governance.

He holds a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2009) from Bahir Dar University and a Master of Engineering in Civil Engineering, specialising in Construction Technology and Management (2016), from Bahir Dar University Institute of Technology. His master's study was supported by a scholarship from the Ethiopian Roads Authority, and his thesis compared the cost and environmental impact of rigid and flexible pavement.

His engineering career began in 2010 as a Site Engineer with the Amhara Rural Roads Authority in Dessie, where he supervised construction crews, prepared cost estimates and kept materials and tools available on site. In 2011 he became District Manager in Gondar, responsible for a road maintenance district: its staff, its fleet of trucks, vehicles and heavy equipment, and its budget and inventory.

From 2017 to 2022 he served as General Manager of Amhara Road Work Enterprise, a GC-1 road works enterprise in Bahir Dar. There he managed construction projects across their lifecycle, negotiated contracts with clients, vendors and subcontractors, enforced site safety, and built the construction team through hiring, training and performance evaluation. From 2020 to 2023 he also served on the Board of Directors of Abay Insurance in Addis Ababa.

Before engineering, he spent a decade teaching mathematics for the Ministry of Education and five years as a Project Coordinator for HAPCO in West Belessa, overseeing community HIV/AIDS prevention and awareness programmes. Those roles involved lesson planning, mentoring new teachers, and organising awareness campaigns and support groups in local institutions.
